cohort: The study included 2811 neonates whose skin was examined within 72 hours of birth in the maternity ward of Centro Hospitalario Pereira Rossell.
finding: All 2811 neonates presented at least one benign, transient skin finding within 72 hours of birth, with lanugo (98%), physiological scaling (79.7%), and sebaceous hyperplasia (73.3%) being the most common.
mod_finding: Erythema toxicum was observed significantly more often after vaginal births (P = .008).
